g.text: Global Flash Jump: Instant Viewport Navigation
Flash & Hint: [f] Viewport Hints • [a-z] Direct Leap • [/] Instant Search Filter
Navigating sidebars, split columns, or wide whitespace with hjkl alone often feels stuck.
Press f to light up collision-free hint tags across the screen, leaping anywhere instantly:

g.text: Modern web articles feature complex multi-column layouts.
Press [d] to leap directly across the gap!
• Press f for Hint mode; press the target key (e.g. d) to leap across barriers directly.
• Press / for dynamic search (flash.nvim); press '' to return precisely.
